The vistahm gain (591-08, region Khorasan, counterpart bahram-chobin) moves only the cells Bahram holds (Iranian Khorasan), and Bahram's mirror loss is suppressed by the matching gain. Cutting the found to Tabaristan + Ardabil and reducing the Bahram 591 keyframe to Media are both consistent. The open point is noted correctly: the page says Vistahm was spahbed of the West before Blarathon and revolted only after Vinduyih's execution, so the 591 found is early (pre-existing, made less wrong).

The Jin page says Jin 'consisted of most of Shanxi' in 907, 'Linfen, Hezhong, Jincheng, Qinyang were taken by Later Liang' and 'In 912, Jin took over Jincheng'. The Later Liang page says Shanxi (Jin) 'remained largely outside Later Liang control'. Overlaps re-resolved with the gazetteer are 0 for 911/907, 908/907, 915/915 and 916/916. The 911 keyframe's to 914 ends the 911-921 Cliopatria span that re-claimed land at the 915 and 916 snaps, and its own note supports it. The 912 Jincheng mirror loss matches Jin /ledger/1.
